articles.summary: Last participant has been randomized and dosed in the Phase 3 APOLLO study of bitopertin in erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP) The study size was expanded to 183 participants due to patient and physician demand Results of the APOLLO study are expected in Q4 2026 WATERTOWN, Mass., March 26, 2026
articles.title: Disc Medicine Announces Completion of Enrollment of Phase 3 APOLLO Trial of Bitopertin in Erythropoietic Protoporphyria
